title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES CREATING A COMMISSION TO ASCERTAIN AND STUDY. THE CONDITIONS OBTAINING IN THE RECLAIMED AREAS AND FORESHORE LANDS IN THE DISTRICT OF TONDO, MANILA.

text.en:
For the purpose of ascertaining and studying the actual
conditions obtaining in the reclaimed areas and foreshore
lands in the District of Tondo, Manila, with a view, to the
adoption of adequate and effective measures to solve the
housing and other social problems in said areas, I, El-
pidio Quirino, President of the Philippines, by virtue of
the powers vested in me by law, do hereby create a
Commission composed of the following:
The Secretary of Fublic Works and Com-
• munications .....
.....
The Social. Welfare Administrator
The Director of Lands
The Director of Planning
The City Engineer, Manila
99
Mr. Andres Dimanahan, President of the
Barrio Fugoso Association
Atty. Leandro Domingo, President of the
Federation of Tondo Storeshore Lands
Tenants Association ....
The Commission shall submit its report and recom-
mendations to the President of the Philippines within
six months from the date of this Order.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
